name: Routing Policy
description: Route each LLM request to the best provider based on a configurable policy that considers cost, latency, capability requirements, provider availability, and user preference. Supports multiple routing strategies: lowest-cost, lowest-latency, most-capable, preference-pinned, and custom weighted scoring.
purpose: Intelligently direct each invocation to the optimal provider given the request's requirements and current system state, balancing cost, performance, and reliability.
acceptanceCriteria: Router accepts an InvocationRequest and returns a selected provider+model pair
Built-in strategies: lowest-cost, lowest-latency, most-capable, preference-pinned, weighted-scoring
Scoring function combines: costScore, latencyScore, capabilityScore, availabilityScore with configurable weights
Router respects user overrides per-request or per-session
Availability is live-checked: provider health endpoint timeout removes from candidate set
Strategy is configurable globally and overridable per-request
Router logs selection reason (not full request) for observability
Detailed routing decision record for debugging: candidates considered, scores, winner, rejection reasons
